name: Secret Dessin
original_name: シークレット・デッサン
source:
"The art club seems erotic...!!!"
Kawakami Shota joined the club, full of hope that he would be able to see as many nude paintings and plaster statues as he wanted.

Kawakami Shota's head is always full of naughty thoughts, and he hides it from those around him. He is a secret pervert, but Asahina Shizuku, the only member of the art club, is also secretly perverted!

What's more, Shizuku asks him to be a model for her drawing...

The secret perverts' club activities begin!​

[Translated from the [url=https://azarashi-soft-plusone.nexton-net.jp/secret-dessin/story.html]original site[/url]]
translation:
“艺术部好像很色情啊……！！！”
川上翔太加入了俱乐部，满怀希望能够看到尽可能多的裸体画和石膏雕像。

川上翔太的脑子里总是充满了顽皮的想法，他对周围的人都隐藏着。他是一个秘密变态，但艺术部唯一的成员朝比奈雫也是一个秘密变态！

更重要的是，雫还请他当她的画作模特……

秘密变态社团活动开始啦！​
